functionalRequirement: In the Facebook settings menu, the system shall allow the user to delete their saved username and password for Facebook.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must securely erase stored Facebook credentials using a cryptographically secure deletion method that overwrites the data at least 3 times to prevent recovery.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures complete and secure removal of sensitive login credentials from the system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The system must provide a clear warning dialog that explains the consequences of deleting saved credentials and require explicit user confirmation before deletion.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents accidental data loss and provides user transparency about the action.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: The system must log the credential deletion event with a timestamp and user ID for audit purposes, without storing the actual credentials.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Maintains a record of important account management actions for security tracking.

functionalRequirement: System shall request a deposit of Rs. 5000 upon entry of valid customer information and update it temporarily in the customer database.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must implement end-to-end encryption for all financial transaction data using AES-256 encryption during transmission and storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects sensitive financial information from unauthorized access or tampering.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The deposit processing and database update must complete within 2 seconds for 99% of transactions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick and responsive handling of financial transactions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The deposit system must maintain 99.99% uptime during business hours with automatic failover mechanisms.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Critical for financial transactions to be consistently accessible.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Authenticity: Implement multi-factor authentication for all deposit transactions, requiring at least two independent verification methods.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Prevents unauthorized financial transactions and verifies customer identity.

functionalRequirement: The system shall generate reports on storage consumption by financial contact.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Resource Utilization: The report generation process must consume no more than 500 MB of memory and utilize less than 30% of CPU resources.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures efficient resource management during report generation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Assistance: Reports must include clear, color-coded visualizations of storage consumption with tooltips explaining each data point.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enhances user understanding of complex storage consumption data.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Analysability: The report generation module must support modular export formats including PDF, CSV, and XML with consistent data representation.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows for easy analysis and integration with other systems.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Adaptability: The reporting system must support dynamic filtering and custom time range selection for storage consumption data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides flexibility in report generation and data analysis.

functionalRequirement: The system shall be able to generate a series of multiple-choice fraction questions that form a cohesive storyline to introduce a specific topic.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Learnability: The question generation interface must provide clear instructions and a consistent layout for each question type.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures users can easily understand and interact with the question generation system.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must generate at least 5 interconnected multiple-choice questions with a coherent narrative structure for each topic.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures comprehensive and contextual question generation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: Question generation must complete within 500 milliseconds for a set of 5 multiple-choice questions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Provides quick and responsive question generation for educational purposes.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modularity: The question generation system must use a plug-in architecture that allows easy addition of new question types and topics.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Enables future expansion and modification of the question generation capabilities.

functionalRequirement: System shall display a confirmation popup after the user fills out the form and clicks the submit button, saving the information to the database for further processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Error Protection: The confirmation popup must clearly display all submitted form data for user review before final submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Allows users to verify information and prevent accidental submissions.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The form submission and database save process must complete within 1 second for 99% of submissions.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures quick and responsive form processing.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: All form data must be validated against predefined rules and sanitized to prevent injection attacks before database storage.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Protects the system from malicious input and ensures data quality.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Recoverability: Implement an automatic retry mechanism with exponential backoff for failed form submissions, with a maximum of 3 retry attempts.
identifiedNFRs.justification: Ensures robust handling of potential temporary system failures during form submission.
